name: Cartorio Incremento 3 manual mock ou API autorizada

parameters.jsCode: const fs=require('fs'); const read=p=>JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8')); const settings=read('/work/settings.json'); if(!['completo','digitalizada','incompleto','contraditorio'].includes(settings.scenario))throw new Error('INVALID_SCENARIO'); const payload=read('/work/input.json'); payload.mode=settings.mode; let approval=null; if(settings.mode==='live'){try{approval=read('/state/live-approval.local.json');}catch{}} return [{json:{payload,options:{manifest:read('/work/preflight.json'),truth:read('/work/expected-'+settings.scenario+'.json'),config:read('/work/openai.json'),approval,ledgerPath:'/state/openai-budget.json'}}}];

__CARTORIO_BUNDLE__
const data=$('Preparar e reservar chamada autorizada').first().json; if(!data.ok)return [{json:data.report}]; const prepared=data.prepared; try{let raw=prepared.mockResponse,httpStatus=200; if(prepared.mode==='live'){const response=$input.first().json; raw=response.body; httpStatus=response.statusCode; if(Buffer.byteLength(JSON.stringify(raw))>prepared.config.limits.maxResponseBytes)throw Object.assign(new Error(),{code:'OPENAI_RESPONSE_LIMIT'}); require('fs').writeFileSync('/results/'+prepared.scenario+'-response.json',JSON.stringify({raw,httpStatus,...prepared.reservation,scenario:prepared.scenario}),{flag:'wx',mode:384});} const result=await Cartorio.evaluate(prepared,raw,{httpStatus}); return [{json:result.report,...(result.bytes?{binary:{minuta:{data:result.bytes.toString('base64'),mimeType:'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document',fileName:'minuta-ficticia.docx'}}}:{})}];}catch(e){return [{json:{status:'blocked',code:e.code||'VALIDATION_FAILED',scenario:prepared.scenario,simulation:prepared.mode==='mock',apiCalls:prepared.mode==='live'?1:0,documentGenerated:false}}];}
